expected: Bootstrap policy, paired inventory, fixed-root runner, and E01 self-test satisfy the frozen plan before any product edit or live capture.
actual: Static inspection found material evidence-policy and runner gaps. E01, E02, B01, and all product checks remain NOT_RUN. No product source, canonical state, GUI ledger, backup file, or LINE UI was changed or accessed.
commands_and_methods: Read plan.md, handoff.md, plan-contract.json, output-policy-bootstrap.json, output-policy-frozen.json, inventory_pair.py, run_command.py, and test_evidence_policy.py.
Inspected narrow source ranges with sed, rg, and nl -ba; inspected JSON fields with Python json.loads.
Computed SHA-256 and byte counts for the audited files.
Called Python compile(source, path, 'exec') in memory for the three present Python tools; this is syntax parsing only, not a formal check or test suite.
Checked that check-specs.json, check-specs-freeze.json, checks/test_run_command.py, formal reports, and evidence/checks outputs were absent at audit time.

evidence: output-policy-frozen.json contains a flat fixed_files list and global output rules, but lacks per-file phase, producer, type, byte cap, and readback/lifecycle fields required by plan.md §5.2.
The inventory comparator accepts any path in fixed_files as an addition without validating the approved producer or stage; it ignores fixed_directories and templates.
compare_baseline_to_pair reads only fixed_files and a nonexistent top-level dynamic_registered_paths field.
It does not expand check_output_rule, inventory_output_rule, gate_output_path_template, dynamic registration receipts, or transaction_path_policy.
It blocks every changed existing path, including receipt-supported canonical state/ledger changes, while B01's own post-scan publications are not part of the baseline pair.
baseline mode compares only scan 1 and scan 2; it does not reconcile bootstrap additions to prewrite anchors, validate protected preimages, or bind/check Git identity.
A successful baseline pair would therefore not establish all G_BASELINE_06 requirements.
The copied runner hardcodes the recovery-02 run root and task ID, so its own location validation and evidence/spec paths do not target minimal-live-06.

The runner checks output collisions but does not take a persistent exclusive check-ID claim before launching; it lacks the required HEAD/branch/empty-index rejection and effective environment-diff recording.
E01 uses a synchronous in-memory scan stub; it does not exercise delayed stream completion or actual no-write behavior during scans.
It does not test tail publication ordering, wrong-cwd/source-drift refusal, unknown-special non-open behavior, or enforcement of pre-write dynamic registration.

historical_context: The three historical LIVE_CLASSIFIER_CHOOSER attempts remain consumed. The plan authorizes one additional bounded collection, but its required D01 attempt-start has not been written and that collection is unconsumed.
stop_reason: The evidence policy/comparator and runner cannot provide trustworthy one-shot checks or preservation gates as written. Revising frozen output/evidence policy or gate semantics requires a higher-level plan decision; no product edit or live operation was started.
requested_decision: Decide whether to close minimal-live-06 as blocked and issue a fresh reviewed continuation with corrected exact output lifecycle and runner/gate contracts, or authorize a bounded revised policy in this continuation before any formal ID is launched. Recommended: fresh reviewed continuation, because output-policy-frozen.json has already been materialized and the current preservation comparator cannot support the planned transaction deltas.
